verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs state that agents can fetch a complete documentation index at https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt and can append .md to any docs page URL to get markdown. Doc pages served at .md URLs (account-types.md, get-account-details.md) appear in the evidence, which corroborates the markdown mechanism. The probe 404s hit different paths (the root /llms.txt and /docs.md), so they do not contradict the documented /docs/llms.txt location. Missing for 10: no hands-on confirmation that /docs/llms.txt resolves, no llms.txt at the conventional site-root path, and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
